message:
WW-4639 Validate that no multipart ContentType header contains OGNL expression (CVE-2017-5638)

JakartaMultiPartRequest: validate Content-Type header value before OGNL evaluation.
Prevents RCE via crafted Content-Type header in Apache Struts2 multipart upload.
Fixes S2-045 / CVE-2017-5638 — critical OGNL injection vulnerability.
Source: https://github.com/apache/struts/commit/352306493971e7d5a756d61780d57a76eb1f519a
author: apache-struts-team
diff:
// Fix: CVE-2017-5638 JakartaMultiPartRequest OGNL injection via Content-Type
// Validate Content-Type header does not contain OGNL expression before parsing
